services.name: Facilities & Rentals
services.desc: The Dakota Community Bank & Trust Ballpark is home to the Dickinson Baseball Club, Dickinson High School Baseball, Dickinson State University Baseball and the Badlands Big Sticks. Within the ballpark are two fields - The stadium field along with Coke Field. The stadium field received new turf in 2023. Dickinson Dike is located next to Turtle Park. This Dike is 19 acres in size and approximately 20 feet deep at its deepest point. Anglers can expect to catch a variety of fish including rainbow trout, cutthroat trout, catfish, largemouth bass, and small bluegill. services.name: Learn to Belay (Climbing Wall)
services.desc: We invite you to register for our Learn-to-Belay course, open to anyone ages 16+ who want to become a certified belayer. Being a certified belayer allows you to climb the West River Community Center climbing wall during open climb hours. For more information on our climbing wall, visit westrivercommunitycenter.com.
